CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

2. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

3. Solve for x: x + 6 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 12
   C. 11
   D. 17

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 17
   D. 16

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 31
   C. 27
   D. 25

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 18

7. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 5

8. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

10. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 2

11. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

12. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 11
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 10 000 m²

2. A — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. C — 11
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 17 − 6
3. x = 11
Final Answer: x = 11
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. D — 16
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 4 × 4
3. Product = 16
Final Answer: 16
Mark reminder: method mark for multiplication; accuracy mark for answer

5. D — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625

Final Answer: 25 cm
